sorry_inventory.statement: theorem deriv_reflect [Nonempty ι] {φ : LabelledFormula Atom} : Deriv 𝒯 (𝒞.unionG) 𝒞.unionΓ φ → ∃ i, Deriv 𝒯 (𝒞.C i).G (𝒞.C i).Γ φ
sorry_inventory.assumption: Assumes every label y a boxI/diaE cofinite premise ranges over reflects to a single chain index; the swap-transport argument (NIK.freshWitness_transport, proven) only establishes this for labels drawn from the chain's shared coinfinite reserve V'^c, not for 'old' labels already present in some chain member's domain.
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Closing the 'old label' case needs either an invariant that Phase 4's concrete Zorn construction only ever extends a context by fresh (reserve-drawn) labels at each step (knowable only once Phase 4's construction exists), or a separate monotonicity-based argument not yet found. Forcing either without the concrete Phase 4 construction risks a subtly wrong general-position proof, matching this task's ~100%/dispatch transcription-defect base rate the plan itself flags.
sorry_inventory.follow_up_task: Phase 4 (Bounded Prime Lemma / Zorn over whole contexts) -- the natural point to discharge this, since it supplies the concrete extension-step invariant

blockers.what_was_tried: Proved the crux label-renaming/equivariance lemma (NIK.swap_relabel, Simpson Prop. 4.4.1 specialized to a two-label swap) and its freshness-transport corollary, fully sorry-free; built the ChainCtx scaffold (union graph/context, sorry-free) mirroring Simpson's single-shared-coinfinite-V' setup; attempted to close the reflection theorem's boxI/diaE cases using freshWitness_transport for witnesses drawn from the shared reserve V'^c.
blockers.why_it_failed: boxI/diaE's cofinite quantifier ranges over ALL of Label Atom, not just the reserve V'^c; for labels y already present in some chain member's domain ('old' labels), the swap-transport argument does not apply (risk of collision with existing structure), and no invariant is yet available (Phase 4 doesn't exist yet) to rule this case out.

continuation_context.next_action_hint: Re-dispatch Phase 3 (or fold into Phase 4's dispatch) to discharge ChainCtx.deriv_reflect's one sorry using Phase 4's concrete Zorn extension-step invariant (each step adjoins only a fresh/reserve-drawn label) -- see the theorem's docstring and the handoff markdown for the two candidate closing routes. The crux equivariance machinery (NIK.swap_relabel, NIK.freshWitness_transport) is done and directly reusable; do not re-derive it.

Built the ChainCtx scaffold (union graph/context, sorry-free) mirroring Simpson's own single-shared-coinfinite-V' Zorn-poset setup (chunk_0102). The reflection theorem itself (ChainCtx.deriv_reflect, and its corollary chain_closure = Task 3's literal deliverable) is landed with ONE precisely-scoped, documented strategic sorry: the swap-transport argument handles witnesses drawn from the chain's shared coinfinite reserve, but not 'old' labels already present in some chain member -- closing this needs Phase 4's concrete construction to supply an extension-step invariant. All work is in probes/ (Cslib/ untouched, zero-debt invariant trivially holds), per the plan's own artifact scoping for this phase.
